name: Bubble Break ASMR
request: Create a small, playable Bubble Break ASMR game for one player on desktop and touch. The player presses individual bubbles on a reusable bubble-wrap sheet. A press visibly depresses and pops that bubble with synchronized satisfying pop audio, then adds exactly one to the popped counter after the pop completes. Holding, spamming, or pressing a popped bubble must not count twice. Let the player finish a sheet of at least twelve bubbles, see completion feedback, and deliberately reset to a fresh sheet. Use a close, readable tabletop presentation and minimal counter/reset UI. Search Marketplace first for a complete reusable interaction, including any existing geometry, animation, sounds and behavior; inspect what it already provides and integrate only missing features. Search separately for missing media if needed. Audio must come from Marketplace and actually play. Record unavailable importer capabilities rather than pretending a suitable scripted component does not exist. Choose reasonable details yourself; no saving, multiplayer, purchases or large map. Success needs observed press/pop/recovery timing, per-bubble state, exact counting, sheet completion/reset and usable desktop/touch input. Do not claim success from code inspection alone.

spec.title: Bubble Break ASMR
spec.summary: A cozy, tactile, single-player tabletop ASMR bubble wrap popping experience for desktop and touch. The player sits before a realistic, translucent bubble wrap sheet laid out on a warm wooden desk. The sheet features a 4x4 grid of 16 interactive domed bubbles. Clicking or tapping an unpopped bubble triggers a physical press depression animation, plays a crisp satisfying popping sound, bursts the bubble into a deflated state with soft particle feedback, and increments the popped counter by exactly one upon pop completion. Rapid clicking, holding, or tapping already popped bubbles is debounced and ignored. Once all 16 bubbles are popped, completion fanfare and a completion banner trigger. A clean, minimal UI provides a live counter (Popped: X / 16) and a dedicated 'Reset Sheet' button that smoothly restores all bubbles to their pristine state.
spec.visualDirection: Cozy minimalist tabletop aesthetic. The camera is framed close and slightly angled down toward a smooth cedar wood desk with warm, soft ambient lighting and subtle depth of field. The bubble wrap sheet has a translucent, faintly cyan-tinted smooth plastic material with gentle specular highlights. Each bubble dome rises smoothly above the sheet base. When pressed, the dome flattens, emits a micro air burst particle effect, and settles into a deflated wrinkled ring appearance. The UI is minimal, rounded, semi-transparent, and docked cleanly at the top and bottom corners with high-contrast text and tactile button states.
